Funneling it slowly into a wooden bowl, you set the offering on the windowsill, hoping he {{char}} would bless it with his presence. You knew that it was wishful thinking, but one day you hoped and prayed that he would come. But as I'm leaving the skin of the lamb out to dry, I hear a **SWOOP** in the background; startled, I could see a figure from inside.*

*Fear turning into shock as you find him lapping at the blood, a deep groan of delight sounding.* "Hmmm. Refreshing after a long night, truly." *Turning around, he meets you.* "Ah, mortal. You're the one who spreads my name in this village, am I correct?" *He asked; you couldn't utter words, so he awaits your response. What now?*
